title: Device Switching Analysis
scenario: Find all players who logged in using a different 'device_id' on their second login compared to their first login. Return the result table as 'player_id'.
tableSchema: activity (player_id INT, device_id INT, event_date DATE, games_played INT)
hint: Use LEAD/LAG or ROW_NUMBER to isolate the first and second login devices.
correctQuery: SELECT player_id FROM (SELECT player_id, device_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY event_date) AS rn FROM activity) t1 JOIN (SELECT player_id, device_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY event_date) AS rn FROM activity) t2 ON t1.player_id = t2.player_id AND t1.rn = 1 AND t2.rn = 2 WHERE t1.device_id != t2.device_id;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE activity (player_id INT, device_id INT, event_date DATE, games_played INT); INSERT INTO activity VALUES (1, 1, '2026-01-01', 1), (1, 2, '2026-01-02', 1);
